cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. That innocent cup started the argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tipped it onto my letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Exactly. A badly positioned cup creates difficult choices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which shows how far the cup had already entered the situation.

mechanism: Copy a cup-emptying gesture without knowing it waters a plant, then attribute the damaged letter and ensuing social consequence to that harmless cup.
confusable: Not solely denying fault: each new consequence must be folded back into the same cup detail while A covers the copied mistake.
comparison: A private letter and a demanded apology rather than a collapsed tent and ruined cake.
seedUse: Retains tipped cup/letter/hand responsibility; adds a copied plant-watering pour with different destination.
